final: WITH c AS (SELECT o.account_id AS account_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM "order" o JOIN account a ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3), df AS (SELECT account_id, region, cnt, cnt - (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM c) AS diff FROM c), r AS (SELECT region, AVG(diff) AS rdiff FROM df GROUP BY region) SELECT df.account_id, df.region, df.cnt AS order_count, df.diff AS diff_from_overall_avg, df.diff - r.rdiff AS excess_over_region_avg_diff FROM df JOIN r ON r.region = df.region WHERE df.diff > r.rdiff ORDER BY excess_over_region_avg_diff DESC, df.account_id LIMIT 10
